records.body:

records.subject: You're in -- let's get River Studio set up
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Welcome to Wrenfield -- excited to have River Studio here. If you get stuck on anything in the first few days, just reply to this email directly and it'll come straight to me.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *River Studio* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Maya explicitly said they're still deciding and asked for another week [email:30205502], signalling a pause, not progress. Day 6 with no project, no invite, no milestone despite welcome email [email:a8ffbfa9] and a held welcome call [calendar:b1b546c6]. Starter, no tickets, no engagement signals, so unaided activation within 8 days is unlikely.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on River Studio's setup
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for being straight with me — totally fair to take another week to decide whether Wrenfield fits River Studio. I won't crowd you in the meantime.

One thing that might make the evaluation easier: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and walk through how your team's work would map into that — otherwise I'll check back in next week.

Best,
Nadia
